|game_text=Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. '''Twisted And Evil''': Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.

|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Rise_Of_The_Dark_Lord.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-riseofthedarklord-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-00-Rise_Of_The_Dark_Lord-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 35). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “(deploys only at start of game)” for “(only at start of game)” and “from your Reserve Deck” for “from Reserve Deck” (it writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck”, which is notation only): “Deploy on table (deploys only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from your Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time.Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to deploy Vader from Reserve Deck, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.”<ref name="cl-1271_19-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
|hatnote=For the later errata text, see [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]].
